<h1>SOIL CRC Benefit-Cost Analysis Tool</h1>
<p>Benefit-cost analysis for farm-practice and soil-management trials.</p>

<section class="content-section"><div class="page-shell narrow">
<div class="tool-facts">
<div class="tool-fact"><h2>Problem</h2><p>Deciding whether an agricultural trial or soil-management intervention is worth its cost requires transparent economic appraisal under uncertainty.</p></div>
<div class="tool-fact"><h2>Users</h2><p>Researchers and partners evaluating agricultural production trials.</p></div>
<div class="tool-fact"><h2>Inputs and outputs</h2><p>Users supply trial assumptions and costs; the underlying tool is designed to return net present value, benefit-cost ratio, return on investment, and sensitivity analysis under alternative scenarios.</p></div>
<div class="tool-fact"><h2>Method</h2><p>Standard benefit-cost analysis with user-supplied assumptions and explicit sensitivity ranges.</p></div>
<div class="tool-fact"><h2>Credits</h2><p>Project lead and publisher: Dr Frank Wogbe Agbola. Developed with Dr Mesfin Genie.</p></div>
<div class="tool-fact"><h2>Limitations</h2><p>Results depend on the assumptions entered and are intended to support appraisal and discussion.</p></div>
</div>
<p class="tool-notice"><strong>Application availability.</strong> The deployable standalone application files are not currently present in this GitHub repository, so this page intentionally does not expose a broken launch link.</p>
</div></section>
